prompt: Complete the segment that distinguishes a Redis Cloud Pro database's private endpoint hostname from its public one.
explanation: Static endpoints start with redis-<port>.c<number>; the private endpoint of the same database inserts the segment internal right after the port — redis-<port>.internal.c<number> — and resolves only inside the private network path set up by VPC peering, Private Service Connect, Transit Gateway, or PrivateLink.
template: A database's static public endpoint looks like redis-12345.c12345.us-east-1-mz.ec2.cloud.rlrcp.com. The private endpoint of the same Pro database follows the pattern redis-12345.___ .c12345.us-east-1-mz.ec2.cloud.rlrcp.com.
